lines.say: LH and FSH, high after menopause, fall; FSH and estradiol levels don't guide treatment
replaces the estrogen they make when they fail or are removed
hot flashes cut by about 75% versus placebo, and night sweats eased
treats vaginal dryness and thinning after menopause
approved to prevent osteoporosis after menopause when non-estrogen drugs can't be used
thyroid function checked in people on thyroid hormone, as its binding protein rises
triglycerides checked if they are known to be high
without a progestogen, endometrial cancer is 2 to 12 times likelier (boxed warning)
tablets raised clots, patches and gels didn't (UK study); related hormones raised stroke
breast cancer risk rises with longer use, and more with a progestogen added
gallbladder disease needing surgery, 2 to 4 times more often in estrogen users

ask: Would a patch or gel be safer for me than a tablet, given my clot and stroke risk?
